mentions.description: A desktop IDE for founders to run their operations. It supports creating deterministic automations and dashboards, with notification systems planned, and pairs with Claude/Codex through a local MCP.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm creating an IDE for founders to run their operations. Create automations (deterministic), dashboards, and soon notification systems. It's a desktop app, and the whole IDE runs in pair with claude/codex through local mcp.
